name: Robert Hooke
summary: Seventeenth-century English natural philosopher, instrument designer, and Curator of Experiments for the Royal Society.

name: Richard Waller
summary: Secretary of the Royal Society and editor of Hooke's Posthumous Works.

name: Royal Society
summary: English learned society for science, founded in 1660.

name: Gresham College
summary: Institution in London where the Royal Society held meetings and where Hooke lived.

name: Isaac Newton
summary: English mathematician and physicist, President of the Royal Society from late 1703.

name: Robert Boyle
summary: Anglo-Irish natural philosopher and chemist, prominent early Fellow of the Royal Society.

name: Henry Oldenburg
summary: First Secretary of the Royal Society and founding editor of Philosophical Transactions.

name: Posthumous Works of Dr Robert Hooke
summary: 1705 collection of Hooke's unpublished papers edited by Richard Waller.

name: Air pump
summary: Experimental apparatus perfected by Hooke for Boyle's experiments.

name: Philosophical Transactions
summary: Scientific journal published by the Royal Society.

name: Trinity College Library
summary: Library at Cambridge University holding Hooke manuscripts.
